heard: A 12-year cosmic voyage is hunting down a record eight asteroids. Launched on October 16, 2021, the ambitious Lucy mission set out across the solar system with a unique cargo on board. Named after famous hominin fossils, the spacecraft carries an actual disk made entirely of lab-grown diamonds. Its ultimate target is six Jupiter-Trojan asteroids trapped securely in the giant planet's orbit. Along the way, Principal Investigator Harold Levison guided the probe right past main-belt asteroid Dinkinish. High-resolution cameras revealed a tiny moon orbiting the rock that was actually a rare contact binary. That surprising hidden moon officially started this record-breaking 12-year cosmic voyage.
